text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
A whole handful of chameleon plant... grind it up before it dries...
Um, and then, the reviving spell is...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Lizard☆Fish☆Chameleon~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Instantly, an unbearable stench shoots from my mouth to my nose, jolting me awake!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ah... You're awake.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ngggh... You're awaaakeeee~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I rub the small back clinging to me, it all registers. Collapsing,
getting carried here... and having a mountain of chameleon plant shoved into my mouth to wake me up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That aside, young as she may be, she's still a horsegirl. The force of her hug
is formidable, and honestly, my spine is creaking—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No! Don't move.
I don't care if it hurts. Just endure it, you dummy!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...*sniff*.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hah?! I wasn't worried at all!!
I'm mad!! I am super, super mad!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're just a Familiar!! Collapsing on your own!!
Scaring me like that!! And not even answering when I call you!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, are you a total DUUUMMY?!
A Familiar troubling his magical girl is a hundred years too early!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...I even brewed three giant plastic bottles full of chameleon plant tea
and stuffed your fridge completely full with them.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Got it?! I won't forgive you unless you drink every last drop!!
I'm gonna come check on you, so you'd better!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho declares with a huff. And yet, I can't help but feel
there's just as much care and warmth brimming behind her voice.
choice_data_list: Understood. I'll make sure to drink it all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph! As long as you understand, fine!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, during our scheduled training session.
Facing Sweep Tosho, I braced myself for whatever tantrum she might throw today, but—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Familiar. ...You know,
when I beat everyone in that race the other day, it felt really good.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Just like the first time I met you. I was annoyed at getting bossed around,
so I ignored it and ran however I wanted... and it felt a little bit good.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It felt good. And a little, just a teeny tiny bit...
I thought it might actually be fun.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Choosing to 'run' on my own terms... thought maybe it's fun.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And to you, running like that
looked 'like magic,' right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I see. ...So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, remember what you said?
'Don't you want to see a bigger world of racing?'

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, remember what you said?
'Don't you want to see a bigger world of racing?'

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What did you mean by that? Why do you think I can find magic there?
...Explain it to me in more detail.
choice_data_list: ...Seeing it for yourself might be faster than explaining!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The following weekend, I take Sweep Tosho to Kyoto Racecourse.
The grandstands were packed with spectators eagerly awaiting the big race.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Imagine? Imagine what?
choice_data_list: You, running before a massive crowd like this.
You, running before a massive crowd like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by the roar of an ecstatic crowd, digging, digging, digging into the manicured turf.
Ahead are rivals bursting with fighting spirit. The race heating up more and more by the second.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Luck, talent, and sheer ability. A grand stage of a lifetime that remains out of reach without having it all,
and seizing glorious victory with everything you've got—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yeah. That actually sounds... kind of fun.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fine, I've decided. I'll give running a shot.
I'll run for you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —I'm going to the Twinkle Series to find magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if I decide to run for myself and have 'fun,'
maybe magic is waiting at the end of that road. ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I guess I can trust what my Familiar says for once.
...After all, I'm a genius magical girl with a huuuuge heart♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At last, she had decided to run of her own free will...!
Swallowing back tears of emotion, I renewed my resolve alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her raw talent is more dazzling than anything.
From here on out, we'll work hand in hand to polish it to perfection—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Or so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
First things first, sweets! Obviously!
Today it's scones. Grandma and I ate them all the time. Nothing boosts your mood better!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...And make sure you eat plenty too, okay?
Fill your belly so you don't go collapsing on me again!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're still my Familiar, from now on and forever!
So you're gonna keep helping me out forever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Got it?
...If you understand, answer me!!
